== Summary ==
Title banner for [[Virtual Block 6]] ("Reflections IV"), from the cover page of the Virtual Set 6: Reflections IV PDF. Its cover reads "Official text as of September 4, 2009". The file was created on 20 April 2010.

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf VirtualBlock6_1.pdf], res.starwarsccg.org. Page 1 rendered at 198 dpi, the resolution of the embedded cover image, and cropped to the banner (1302&times;801 pixels). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195540/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock6_1.pdf Internet Archive].

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-1/1a/Set-VB6-logo.jpg Internet Archive item].
